name: Omni Mount Washington Resort
insider_take: This grand dame of the White Mountains has been the crown jewel of New Hampshire hospitality since 1902, where old-world elegance meets alpine adventure in spectacular fashion.
whats_special: The historic Omni Mount Washington Resort is where the famous Bretton Woods Agreement was signed in 1944, establishing the post-WWII international monetary system. The resort's iconic red roof and white façade create a striking contrast against Mount Washington's dramatic backdrop, while its 2,600-acre estate offers year-round activities from championship golf to world-class skiing.
pro_tip: Book a room on the mountain-facing side for breathtaking sunrise views of Mount Washington, and don't miss the complimentary resort tours that reveal fascinating historical details about this National Historic Landmark.
dont_miss: Take the historic Mount Washington Cog Railway, just minutes away—it's the world's first mountain-climbing cog railway and offers stunning panoramic views. Also experience the resort's famous Cave dining experience and explore the nearby Mount Washington Observatory Weather Discovery Center.
pros: Historic grand hotel with stunning White Mountain views and elegant architecture
Exceptional four-season recreational activities including golf, skiing, and spa services
Multiple dining venues and world-class meeting facilities for events
Family-friendly resort with activities for all ages year-round
cons: Remote mountain location requires advance planning for dining and activities
Premium pricing reflects luxury resort amenities and historic property status
